description: Search the register for a supplier (firm) by name or line of business. Returns names, countries, ids and endpoints. Needs an Enterprise Data key: X-API-Key header on the MCP request (https://assay-systems.com/api-key/#data).

country.description: Two-letter country code in lower case, e.g. ca, us, gb, ua. assay_countries lists them.

q.description: Name or words, two letters or more.

name: assay_search
title: Search suppliers
